tools.name: spawn_task
tools.description:
Set up a scheduled task: work that starts on its own when the task falls due, reading only what the task carries.

Its work can speak only in the connections it suggests. Write a local time with no UTC offset, and give a zone, only where one was named. A task you were shown by its T label is replaced by one spawn naming it in replaces; find any other with list_tasks first. “Snooze 10 minutes” or “again tomorrow”, after a task's message, is a new one-off task with the same instruction, written from what you were shown of the episode that wrote the message, suggesting the connection it was said in. Skipping a rule's next occurrence (“skip tomorrow's”) is a spawn replacing it with the same rule from the local date after the skipped one, or its cancel where none would follow before its until. “Tomorrow at 9 instead” is that skip and a one-off task at the new time, in the same round.
